title: 3 PowerShell Commands Every Windows User Should Know (PREVIEW, real outputs pending)

phrases.speak: Three PowerShell commands to check your Windows security!
phrases.show: Three PowerShell commands to check your Windows security!

phrases.speak: All three are read-only, so they change nothing.
phrases.show: All three are read-only, so they change nothing.

phrases.speak: First, check which DNS servers your computer uses. Unexpected addresses deserve a closer look.
phrases.show: First, check which DNS servers your computer uses. Unexpected addresses deserve a closer look.

phrases.speak: Run it, then read the addresses for each adapter.
phrases.show: Run it, then read the addresses for each adapter.

phrases.speak: Second, check BitLocker. Is your drive encryption protection enabled?
phrases.show: Second, check BitLocker. Is your drive encryption protection enabled?

phrases.speak: ProtectionStatus and VolumeStatus show what Windows reports.
phrases.show: ProtectionStatus and VolumeStatus show what Windows reports.

phrases.speak: Third, see your latest Windows updates and when they were installed.
phrases.show: Third, see your latest Windows updates and when they were installed.

phrases.speak: It lists recent hotfixes, not your full update history.
